en: Vintage printed postcard-style illustration showing a dramatic rocky cliff formation rising above a river, with forested hills in the background. In the foreground are small rowboats with people on the water and on the riverbank, and a promenade with ladies and gentlemen in 19th‑century clothing near a riverside pavilion or building. The main caption in red type reads "Hans Heiling bei Karlsbad und Eibogen." The publisher credit in smaller text at the bottom reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."
